Dear Jessica,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0431982.
The ticket was opened by SMEG regarding high number of OCPP messages "secc is offline" on charger
9hEDCg.

I will monitor the behavior of the charger in the next days, and I will provide you a feedback next week.
